places.name: Niš Fortress
places.ai_summary: A historic fortress located on the banks of the Nišava River, featuring well-preserved walls and cultural events.

opening_hours.notes: Some attractions within the fortress may have specific hours.

places.place_tip: Explore the Ottoman-era gates and the central park.

places.name: Skull Tower (Ćele Kula)
places.ai_summary: A chilling yet significant historical monument built from the skulls of Serbian revolutionaries, symbolizing the fight for freedom.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on public holidays.

places.place_tip: Learn about the history behind this unique monument.

places.name: Mediana Archaeological Site
places.ai_summary: An important archaeological site with remains of a Roman villa, featuring intricate mosaics and historical artifacts.

opening_hours.notes: Last entry one hour before closing.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the well-preserved mosaics.

opening_hours.notes: Advance booking recommended for treatments.

places.ai_summary: A memorial park dedicated to the victims of fascism, featuring a large monument and peaceful green spaces.

opening_hours.notes: The monument is best viewed in the morning or late afternoon light.

places.place_tip: Visit the memorial and take a walk in the park.

places.ai_summary: An annual jazz festival held in Niš, featuring local and international jazz musicians.

opening_hours.notes: Takes place annually in August.

places.place_tip: Enjoy performances in the unique setting of the Niš Fortress.

places.place_tip: Book tickets in advance for popular shows.

opening_hours.notes: Guided tours available.

places.place_tip: Take a guided tour for detailed historical context.

places.ai_summary: A museum showcasing the history and culture of Niš, with archaeological finds, historical artifacts, and art exhibitions.

opening_hours.notes: Check for special exhibitions and events.

places.place_tip: Explore the archaeological section for ancient artifacts.

places.name: St. Sava Park
places.ai_summary: A large public park in Niš, perfect for a leisurely stroll, with a playground, sports facilities, and a café.

opening_hours.notes: A great place for a picnic or relaxation.

places.place_tip: Visit the café for a local snack.

places.ai_summary: A scenic riverside promenade in Niš, ideal for walking, jogging, and enjoying the view of the Nišava River.

opening_hours.notes: Best enjoyed on foot or by bike.

places.place_tip: Bring a camera for great photo opportunities.

places.name: Holy Trinity Cathedral
places.ai_summary: An impressive Serbian Orthodox cathedral in Niš, known for its beautiful frescoes and peaceful courtyard.

opening_hours.notes: Dress modestly when visiting.

places.place_tip: Take time to admire the frescoes.

places.name: Tinkers Alley (Kazandžijsko Sokače)
places.ai_summary: A charming street in Niš, known for its traditional crafts, souvenir shops, and vibrant atmosphere.

opening_hours.notes: Best explored on foot.

places.place_tip: Look for unique handmade souvenirs.

places.name: Čegar Hill Monument
places.ai_summary: A monument commemorating the Battle of Čegar, offering panoramic views of Niš and the surrounding area.

opening_hours.notes: The site may be closed during winter months due to weather conditions.

places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes for the hike up.

places.place_tip: Bring a camera for stunning photos.

places.ai_summary: A hall displaying a rich collection of archaeological artifacts from Niš and the surrounding region.

opening_hours.notes: Check for special exhibitions and events.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the ancient coins and jewelry.

places.name: Niš Tower Viewpoint
places.ai_summary: A viewpoint offering a panoramic view of Niš, the Nišava River, and the surrounding countryside.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited at sunrise or sunset.

places.place_tip: Bring binoculars for a closer look at the landscape.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning for fresh produce.

places.place_tip: Try the local cheese and cured meats.
